shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air, cross-level work/hauling/medical/power/pipes/climate, stairs/ladders/elevators, one-colony UI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only. DBH + VEF PipeSystem soft compat (typed bridges, clean signatures); Reverse Commands soft compat (reflection-only, zero typerefs).
- Cap: 3 levels per column. Basement solid mineable rock, thick-roofed, 12C.
- Animal policy (conservative): pets follow master, obedient pets get send gizmos, non-pen unrestricted pets cross for food; pen animals never.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only. Modern Suite parity contract for any styled UI.

## Vertical transport
- Stairs (1x), ladder (1.6x, no power link, rotatable edge-hugging), grand staircase 2x2 (0.6x, quality scales climb), elevator (0.35x, power bridge, Extend shaft gizmos, ground car holds both links, two-hop rides auto-continue).
- Climb = 90t x type x quality x settings slider. All minifiable (uninstall collapses the far side, no refund; reinstall spawns fresh). Bomb >= 40 punches constructed rooftops.
- All consumers resolve links via CounterpartTowards(map); stair jobs carry their exit in targetC.
- Mounted riders (Giddy-Up) blocked from stairs jobs; mounts carrying riders skipped by the pet follow pull.
- Stairs do NOT unroof anything below (user decision 2026-07-19: no unroofed messes). Sky-side landing platforms (footprint+1) are RoofSurface, exempt from air-reversion while their stairs stand (LevelSync.IsStairsPlatform), reverting normally once destroyed.

## Sky surface model (final spec 2026-07-19, user-confirmed)
- Two owned terrains only: AB_OpenAir (see-through, impassable) and AB_RoofSurface (corrugated steel rooftop, walk/build).
- Mapping: constructed roof below = rooftop; natural roofs are GENERATION-TIME only (thin-roof rim becomes vanilla rough stone of the local rock; thick mass = mountain); no roof = open air. Landing platforms exempt as above.
- Mountains: mass erodes one step to a walkable LEDGE ring (kept by user request, unfogged); the wall core is solid rock + thick rock roof + FULL fog - reads exactly like a vanilla unexplored mountain, faces reveal on approach. Rim + mass terrain use the rock type's naturalTerrain. Ore lumps in the mass.
- Sync: genstep snapshot; live RoofChanged events (constructed only); subscription retry (250t) + ReconcileRooftops sweep (FinalizeInit + 2000t) as self-heal, both platform-exempt.

## See-below renderer (final architecture 2026-07-19)
- Static pass: lower map's section meshes drawn through cloned materials in a queue band derived at RUNTIME from a real terrain material's queue (guessed constants broke twice - vanilla's terrain queue sat between the guessed bands). Band under the ceiling: terrain -300 ... things -200 + altitude step ... overlays -80; every sky material draws after, and therefore over, the below view. Cache per (material, queue).
- Dynamic pass: ONE-WAY MIRROR rule (user spec) - a below thing draws only if its cell is unroofed (any roof kind), unfogged, in camera view, and under open air. Pawns under roofs/rooftops/mountains are simply invisible. Filtered per-thing loop mirroring vanilla's singleThreadedDrawing path (DynamicDrawPhase(Draw)); reflection fallback to the old unfiltered pass if drawThings is unavailable.
- Air-cells light mask (night cap 0.45) on the FogOfWar queue, geometry only over air cells; silhouettes suppressed; ceiling hints; far clip 70.
- Weather decider suppressed on pocket levels; surface sync sole driver.

## Systems (T0-T10 verified in-game 2026-07-19)
- Logistics: outbound haul + inbound fetch WorkGiver + demand pull (construction, bill shortfalls with aggregated alternatives, patient/prisoner meals) + export pinning + deterministic carried-cargo delivery after transfer.
- Build designator stuff picker is column-aware (pattern-guarded transpiler; ResourceCounter augmentation feeds the def source).
- Needs: rest routes to owned bed anywhere in column (two-hop) or free bed on linked level; food redirect for colonists and eligible pets.
- Medical/prisoners: cross-level rescue WorkGiver + capture float order via CarriedIntent continuations.
- One-colony UI: tables append other levels (ghouls in Schedule only; Fluffy Animal Tab via its RecachePawns); colonist bar groups ordered sky/surface/basement; level view buttons in the global controls row (Declutter UI bypass); camera preserves position and zoom; beds alert aggregates the column.
- Power/pipes/climate bridge per link; ABPendingOrders replayed by StairTransfer on arrival.
- Ore generation: ABOreGen lumps (vanilla commonality weights, modded ores included) in basement fill + sky mountain walls, 6/10k cells, natural non-resource rock only.

## Performance architecture (2026-07-19 optimization pass)
- ABGuard switches are plain bools; LevelComp.AnySkyLevels static gate for hot temp getters; NearestUsableStairsCached per-tick memo; shared stairs-job helpers + WithPawnAt; small caches (Ext, meals, tooltips, ABIcons). Recurring: weather 150t, pipes/climate 250t, power 10t hash, rooftop sweep 2000t. Zero recurring cost with no levels built.

## Compat
- DBH + VEF pipe bridges (live-verified); Reverse Commands cross-level float menu; Fluffy Animal Tab append; Declutter UI SuppressExternal bypass; Giddy-Up mounted block; incompatibleWith telardo.MultiFloors + ZLevels1.1; RimThreaded unsupported; foreign pocket maps read as standalone level-0.

## Documented accepted limitations
- Floating rim/ledge rock on natural roof loss (rare, now includes rough-stone rim cells); sky projectile dim over air (cosmetic); tall below-sprites (trees) clip hard at rooftop edges (by construction); bill radius vs stairs delivery; couples counted as singles in beds alert; RC scope direct links only; restaurants do not span levels; stuff picker sees direct links only.
- Threat policy: pocket levels raid-free; opt-ins slated for T8.

## Tranche plan
- T0-T10 DONE. Optimization + compat pass DONE. Playtest rounds 2-4 DONE (2026-07-19): column stuff picker, ore gen, subscription retry + reconcile, corrugated rooftop, runtime-derived queue band, one-way-mirror dynamic filter, vanilla-style fogged mountains with kept ledges, rock-roof def removed for vanilla rough stone, landing platform exemption. Pending relaunch verification of the round-4 spec.
- Next: T5 publishing prep (field manual, Steam description, dependency audit, publish-hold, final regression with and without companions).
- Backlog: T8 threat opt-ins, T9 pipe depth, T11 world integration.

## Status
Round-4 spec (user-confirmed) implemented and compiling. Awaiting relaunch verification, then T5 publishing prep.
